## AvatarFollow.update

[Implementation, line 43](../../../../../src/render/entity/avatar-motion.ts#L43)

Smooth the on-foot avatar like the cameras: a critically damped follower with velocity
feed-forward for the position and one with turn-rate feed-forward for the heading. Steady
walking, sprinting and turning have no lag; physics jitter, steps, landings and snappy
heading changes are filtered. Jumps of more than `snapDistance` (teleports, getting off a
vehicle, portals) snap.

```ts
update(target: THREE.Vector3, yaw: number, dt: number, settings: Pick< typeof gameCameraDefaults, 'avatarFollowResponse' | 'avatarYawResponse' | 'maxStepSeconds' > = gameCameraDefaults, snapDistance = 2): void
```

Direct call sites (syntactic references, not a purity or execution-order guarantee):

- `Math.exp`
- `Math.max`
- `Math.min`
- `Number.isFinite`
- `criticalStep`
- `this.follow.position.distanceTo`
- `this.follow.reset`
- `this.follow.update`
- `wrapAngle`

## EjectionTumble.update

[Implementation, line 98](../../../../../src/render/entity/avatar-motion.ts#L98)

Pose `model` (the monitor inside the avatar group) on top of its normal motion. `velocity`
is the smoothed avatar velocity in the avatar's own frame. Returns false when idle.

```ts
update(model: THREE.Object3D, ejection: RiderEjection | null, velocity: THREE.Vector3, dt: number, drop = 0, riseSeconds = ejectionDefaults.riseSeconds): boolean
```
